stem.text: Which graph correctly shows relative electronegativity plotted against relative atomic radius for the elements $\text{Na}$, $\text{Mg}$, $\text{Al}$ and $\text{Si}$?

A.alt: Graph A: electronegativity (y) against atomic radius (x); points Si, Al, Mg, Na lie on a falling line with Si highest and Na lowest

B.alt: Graph B: electronegativity (y) against atomic radius (x); Si lowest-left, then Al, Mg, Na, with Al highest

C.alt: Graph C: electronegativity (y) against atomic radius (x); points rise from Si to Al to Mg to Na

D.alt: Graph D: electronegativity (y) against atomic radius (x); points Si, Al, Mg, Na fall from upper-left to lower-right
